name: Pieter Botha
bio: Pieter's journey into motorsport logistics began unexpectedly after a career in supply chain management for a mining company near Johannesburg. Frustrated with the corporate world, he took a chance on a local racing team, initially volunteering to organize their transport and equipment. His meticulous approach and uncanny ability to anticipate logistical challenges quickly impressed the team owner, leading to a full-time role. He joined PEX Motorsport five years ago, and has been instrumental in streamlining their operations, ensuring equipment and personnel are always where they need to be, on time and within budget. Pieter's demanding nature stems from his belief that precision is paramount in a sport where milliseconds can mean the difference between victory and defeat. His innovative problem-solving keeps PEX Motorsport competitive.

physical.description: Pieter has a sturdy build and a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People'.
Insists on color-coding all equipment crates.
Drinks Rooibos tea exclusively, even in the sweltering heat.
